invariants.rationale: The method delegates to a MetaClient method returning a String, so result should never be null.
The commit action type is expected to be a non-empty string identifying the commit action. An empty string would be semantically meaningless.
The result is directly returned from table.getMetaClient().getCommitActionType().
The result is declared and returned as a String.
Beyond non-emptiness, it's likely the commit action type has meaningful content and is not just whitespace.
